_readme: DEMO DATASET — NOT A LIVE REGISTRY FEED.
Two different kinds of information live in this file, and they are NOT equally reliable:
1. gs1PrefixRanges — factual, widely published allocation data: the EAN-13 company-prefix
ranges 890-899 are allocated to India by GS1 (https://www.gs1.org/standards/barcodes-epcrfid-id-keys/gs1-general-specifications).
The app uses this only to say 'the barcode prefix is in the range allocated to India'.
A non-89x prefix is reported as 'issued outside the India range' — never as invalid.
2. sampleCompanies — illustrative demo records only. GS1 India does not publish a
key-free public company-prefix lookup, so these entries could not be verified from the
build sandbox. They exist to exercise the lookup path. A prefix that is not listed
returns 'not in demo dataset — cannot verify', never 'invalid'. Replace with a live
GEPIR lookup before any public use.
Checksum validation (last digit of an EAN-13) is pure arithmetic on the barcode itself and
needs no registry — that part is real verification, and the UI says so.
source: GS1 prefix ranges (published) + demo company dataset
